en.name: JWT Generator
en.short: Create and sign test JWTs with HS256, RS256, ES256 and more.
en.title: JWT Generator: create and sign test tokens online
en.description: Create and sign JSON Web Tokens online: choose the algorithm (HS256, RS256, PS256, ES256, EdDSA…), write the payload and the key, and get the token. Generates demo keys locally. 100% in your browser.
en.lead: Write a payload, pick an algorithm and a key, and get a signed token. Nothing is stored or sent.

errors.payload: The payload must be a valid JSON object.
errors.key: The key could not be used with this algorithm.
errors.secret: Write a secret to sign the token.

en.publicKeyHint: Use this public key to verify the token. The pair was generated in your browser and is only kept in this tab.
